product.title: Atlas enciclopedic al lumii
product.description: De la vârfurile semețe ale Munților Himalaya și pădurile tropicale din Africa până la clădirile antice din Europa și megaorașele din Asia, Atlasul enciclopedic al lumii aduce lumea la viață cu ajutorul unor hărți spectaculoase. Unde este cel mai călduros loc de pe planetă? Care este cea mai populată țară de pe Pământ? Unde poți găsi cel mai mare fluture din lume? Care este cel mai aglomerat punct de frontieră din lume?   Peste 60 de hărți uimitoare, create special pentru acest volum, te vor purta într-o călătorie fascinantă, de pe un continent pe altul, într-un ocol al Pământului pe care nu îl vei uita niciodată.

# The Comprehensive Encyclopedia Atlas of the World by Litera

Embark on an unparalleled journey around the globe with the **Encyclopedia Atlas of the World**. This magnificent volume transforms geography into a living story, taking you from the highest peaks of the Himalayan Mountains and through tropical African jungles to the ancient cities of Europe and modern mega-cities across Asia. If you are looking for a definitive resource that brings global knowledge to life, this atlas is your ultimate guide.

The **Atlas enciclopedic al lumii** (Encyclopedia Atlas of the World) is more than just a collection of maps; itâs a detailed educational tool designed for curious minds, making complex world geography engaging and visually stunning.

This spectacular atlas features over 60 unique and beautifully crafted maps, ensuring that your learning journey never gets dull. It guides you across every corner of the planet, allowing readers to answer fascinating questions like: *Where is the warmest place on Earth? What is the world's most populous country?* or *What are the busiest border points globally?*

**Key Features Included:**

*   **Global Scope:** Coverage spans from tropical rainforests in Africa to dense urban centers in Asia.
*   **Historical Depth:** Details about ancient European civilizations and modern global development.
*   **Educational Focus:** Designed to teach students and lifelong learners how the world works, covering diverse biomes and cultures.
*   **Stunning Visuals:** The custom-created maps make studying geography an enjoyable adventure from continent to continent.

## ð Why Choose Literaâs World Atlas?

Published by Litera, this atlas provides a reliable and comprehensive look at global geography suitable for educational use across all age groups. Whether tracing the paths of historical trade routes or comparing modern economies, the visual format makes understanding the planet intuitive and memorable. It is the perfect resource to enhance classroom learning or satisfy your personal curiosity about world travel.

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this atlas suitable for children?**
A: Yes. While highly detailed, the engaging nature of the maps and the scope of the content make it an ideal educational tool for students who are eager to learn about global geography.

**Q: Does the book cover physical geography or only political boundaries?**
A: It covers both. You will find spectacular representations of diverse biomes, major landmarks, population centers, and detailed continental mapping alongside political boundaries.
